note: P1 case-map rows for the +25 exports / +11 S3 methods / -2 removed exports since gllvmTMB 0.7.0 (D-295 Packet 1 row 3). Every classification here is PROPOSED for the maintainer to sign in PR review; disposition is null on every row -- nothing is signed by an agent.

rows.reason: AR1/OU process with unstructured per-trait covariance; native temporal source with no Julia twin yet.
AR1/OU process with per-trait independent covariance; R's most-documented temporal source, no Julia twin yet.
AR1/OU rank-one latent-loading temporal family; no Julia twin yet.
Extracts temporal covariance-provider state/parameters; depends on the temporal_* twins landing first.
Forecasts a native temporal covariance model; bounded contract (unreplicated Gaussian temporal_indep only).
Parametric bootstrap for the temporal persistence parameter; same bounded contract as forecast_temporal.
Profiles the temporal persistence/decay parameter; depends on the temporal_* twins.
Compares supplied temporal model candidates (model-selection helper); depends on the temporal_* twins.
Cumulative-logit ordinal-threshold family for the multivariate engine, distinct from R's missing-predictor cumulative_logit; no Julia twin under this name yet.
Per-unit latent-variable score point extraction; Julia has latent-variable fits but no matching extractor API.
Fallback S3 method (warns on an unrecognized class); twins the default-dispatch behaviour of extract_latent_scores.
Delegates to component fits' extract_latent_scores(); twins Julia's own multi-fit extraction once extract_latent_scores lands.
Extracts scores from an R-only simulated site-trait object class; Julia has no matching simulation-result class to extract from. PROPOSED -- recon flagged this as possibly excluded, not yet decided.
Extracts scores from R's variational-approximation fit class; Julia has no VA-fit class. PROPOSED -- recon flagged this as possibly excluded, not yet decided.
Wald-form per-unit covariance of ordination (latent) scores; needs a Julia surface.
Printer for ordination_uncertainty's result table; twins its display once ordination_uncertainty lands.

Rank-selection by AIC/BIC/AICc from a fitted sequence, paired with anova(test="chibar"). Built by the auto-d lane (#518, gllvmTMB #1324); this ledger only records it -- Shinichi signs this row (D-295 Packet 1 row 6). Fence: R rejects fits with a non-positive-definite Hessian; Julia's select_lv does not currently reproduce that rejection.
Printer for select_lv's rank-selection output. Same auto-d-lane ownership and Shinichi-signs fence as select_lv (D-295 Packet 1 row 6).

TRUE zero-inflation mixture (per-trait, intercept-only structural-zero probability); Julia's own zero-inflated/two-part family is a hurdle-style construction, not R's mixture semantics. A name match never counts (D-295 Packet 1 row 5); Julia's design stays a documented extra until a twin with R's semantics exists.
TRUE zero-inflation mixture reusing ordinary per-trait NB2 dispersion; Julia's two-part ZI uses one scalar dispersion across species. Same D-295 row 5 divergence rule as zi_poisson.
TRUE zero-inflation mixture over multi-trial (binomial) data. Same D-295 row 5 divergence rule as zi_poisson.

Self-Liang chi-bar-square p-value for a boundary LRT. Julia has both `chibar2_pvalue` and `variance_lrt` names in src/boundary_inference.jl, but a name match never counts (D-295 Packet 1 row 5) -- semantic equality is unchecked until a twin test shows equal outputs.
Self-Liang LRT wrapper for one or more variance-component boundaries, used by anova(). Same name-only-match caveat as chibar2_pvalue.
Wraps stats::AIC() with fit-compatibility checks (penalty k=2 default); Julia already has an `aic` extractor but no matching S3-dispatched twin surface for a multi-fit object.
Wraps stats::BIC() with fit-compatibility checks; same S3-twin gap as AIC.gllvmTMB_multi.
Sequential rank/fixed-effect LRT via chi-bar-square (approx) or chi-square, with a rank-step caveat; Julia has no anova-style model-comparison surface yet.
Printer for anova.gllvmTMB_multi's comparison table; twins its display once anova.gllvmTMB_multi lands.
Refit wrapper for a temporal-latent model; depends on the temporal_* twins (A6) landing first.

Design 131 IID response-column coefficients. Column-coefficient grammar is outside the P1 boundary by signed disposition (D-295: a Gaussian point model with no intervals in R, 109 R files, ~25,724 lines); revisit at P2.
Design 131 animal-pedigree/relmat response-column coefficients. Same column-grammar D-295 boundary exclusion as column_coef.
Design 131 phylogenetic (tree/vcv) response-column coefficients. Same column-grammar D-295 boundary exclusion as column_coef.
Design 131 dense-kernel response-column coefficients. Same column-grammar D-295 boundary exclusion as column_coef.
Design 131 SPDE/Matern-field response-column coefficients. Same column-grammar D-295 boundary exclusion as column_coef.

Formula-sugar desugar (brms-style) for ordinary response-column slopes; returns invisible(NULL), never evaluated. Corrected 2026-09-27: R's own capability-status groups slope with phylo_slope/animal_slope/kernel_slope/spatial_slope as the single 'Response-column slope family' row (scope-limited, Gaussian long-format, predictor-only) -- the model it desugars to is column-grammar, not a plain twin, so it is classified with the column-coefficient family under the same D-295 boundary exclusion.
Formula-sugar desugar for fixed-kernel response-column slopes; same 2026-09-27 column-grammar correction as `slope`.

Formula-sugar desugar for spatial (normalized SPDE) response-column slopes. Spatial is outside the P1 boundary by signed disposition (D-295): Julia keeps its own SPDE/Matern stack as a documented extra, not a twin of R's spatial surface.
